description.en: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: two interpenetrating prismatic crystals form a natural cruciform solid. Keep secondary texture subordinate to the diagnostic geometry; choose one composition, not counted variants.
description.zh: 采用原创低多边形几何突出：两枚柱状晶体贯穿连生，形成天然十字实体。次要纹理服从识别结构；只计一种构图，不靠变体增数。

sources.title: US National Museum Mineral Catalogue: Staurolite
sources.supports: Natural prismatic staurolite frequently forms cruciform twins; do not reproduce cut decorative stones
sources.access_origin: inherited inventory research; not reopened by this planner
sources.rights_note: Consultation is not a license to redistribute source media.

reconstruction_notes.en: Geological-form artistic concept: two unequal six-sided prismatic crystals interpenetrate around an intentional boolean-unioned growth center. Original broad facets, modest end asymmetry and softened edges; warm brown opaque mineral palette. Nominal 60-degree composition and 0.12 m scale are art choices, not measured crystal faces or a precise twin-law reconstruction. No bolts, central connector, source-media textures or matrix added.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 地质形态艺术概念：两枚不等长六侧柱晶围绕有意布尔合并的交生中心贯穿连生。原创宽晶面、轻微不对称端部与柔化棱边，采用温暖棕色不透明矿物色系。约60度构图及0.12米为艺术设定，不是精确晶面测量或双晶律复原。不添加螺栓、中心连接件、来源图像贴图或围岩。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
